title: Support for Anthropic Code execution tool

linked_prs.title: feat(providers/anthropic): add code execution tool support
linked_prs.body:

## Background

<!-- Why was this change necessary? -->

[Anthropic provider has server side code execution tool support, similar to web search.](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool)

## Summary

<!-- What did you change? -->

Added support for server side code execution

The code execution tool requires a beta header to be passed
`"anthropic-beta: code-execution-2025-05-22"`
[The code execution tool requires no additional parameters](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool#tool-definition)




## Manual Verification

<!--
For features & bugfixes.
Please explain how you *manually* verified that the change works end-to-end as expected (excluding automated tests).
Remove the section if it's not needed (e.g. for docs).
-->

I tested the Anthropic messages API
I verified the current AI SDK doesn't support
`const codeExecutionTool = anthropic.tools.codeExecution_20250522();`
After implementing, I tested my own build locally.
